description: Source code defining a MySQL Record Manager class and its initialization logic, including schema creation, data source management, and key operations, for use within a larger application.

classes.name: MySQLRecordManager_RecordManager
classes.description: Implements the INode interface, manages configuration and initialization for MySQL record management.

classes.name: MySQLRecordManager
classes.description: Handles schema creation, data source connection, key existence checks, listing, updating, and deleting records in MySQL.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the record manager with credentials and configuration, sets up connection parameters.

methods.name: sanitizeTableName
methods.description: Sanitizes and validates table names for MySQL compatibility.

methods.name: getDataSource
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new DataSource connection to MySQL.

methods.name: createSchema
methods.description: Creates necessary tables and indexes in MySQL if they do not exist.

methods.name: getTime
methods.description: Retrieves current timestamp from MySQL server.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Upserts records into MySQL, handling both new and old formats.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks existence of given keys in the database.

methods.name: listKeys
methods.description: Lists keys based on filtering options.

methods.name: deleteKeys
methods.description: Deletes specified keys from the database.
